questions.question: What do the predicted probabilities fit during training?
questions.question_ar: ماذا تلائم الاحتمالات المتنبأ بها أثناء التدريب؟
questions.explanation: The coefficients are not normally chosen by hand. The training algorithm adjusts them to make the predicted probabilities fit the observed labels. For binary classification, a common objective is binary cross-entropy (log loss):

questions.question: Which objective is commonly used for binary Logistic Regression?
questions.question_ar: أي هدف يستخدم عادة في Logistic Regression الثنائي؟
questions.explanation: 30. Learn coefficients: Estimate the intercept and feature coefficients by optimizing the logistic loss, commonly binary cross-entropy, often with regularization.

questions.question: What can regularization help control in Logistic Regression?
questions.question_ar: ما الذي قد يساعد التنظيم على التحكم به في Logistic Regression؟
questions.explanation: Can use regularization to help control overfitting.

questions.question: What change does a Logistic Regression coefficient describe?
questions.question_ar: أي تغير يصفه معامل Logistic Regression؟
options: the change in class count after removing a feature
change in the log-odds of the positive class
the probability of the class before seeing any features
from negative infinity to positive infinity
options_en: the change in class count after removing a feature
change in the log-odds of the positive class
the probability of the class before seeing any features
from negative infinity to positive infinity
options_ar: التغير في عدد الفئات بعد إزالة خاصية
التغير في لوغاريتم أرجحية الفئة الموجبة
احتمال الفئة قبل مشاهدة أي خاصية
من سالب ما لا نهاية إلى موجب ما لا نهاية
questions.explanation: A coefficient describes the change in the log-odds of the positive class associated with a one-unit increase in that feature, holding the other features constant. The odds ratio for a one-unit increase is exp(bᵢ).
questions.explanation_ar: التغير في لوغاريتم أرجحية الفئة الموجبة

questions.question: If a coefficient is 0.7, what odds ratio follows from a one-unit increase?
questions.question_ar: إذا كان المعامل 0.7، فما نسبة الأرجحية الناتجة عن زيادة وحدة واحدة؟
questions.explanation: For example, if bᵢ = 0.7, then exp(0.7) ≈ 2.01. Under the model, a one-unit increase in that feature multiplies the odds of Class 1 by about 2.01, holding other features constant. This is an odds interpretation, not a direct doubling of probability.

questions.question_ar: مع معامل 0.7، ماذا تعني نسبة أرجحية تقارب 2.01؟
options: multiplies the odds of Class 1 by about 2.01
the probability of the class before seeing any features
the change in class count after removing a feature
the probability of Class 1 directly doubles

questions.question: What model type is Logistic Regression?
questions.explanation: |Model type|Discriminative: models P(Y | X).|Generative: models P(X | Y) and P(Y).|

questions.question: What model type is Naive Bayes?
questions.explanation: |Model type|Discriminative: models P(Y | X).|Generative: models P(X | Y) and P(Y).|

questions.question: Which assumption is not required by Logistic Regression?
questions.question_ar: أي افتراض لا تتطلبه Logistic Regression؟
questions.explanation: |Feature assumption|No conditional-independence assumption is required.|Uses a conditional- independence assumption in its standard form.|
